errors.text_span: This pie chart illustrates a comparison of categories, labeled as "Categorical," "Approximate Number Generation," "Disjunctive & Conjunctive." The chart is divided into eight slices.
errors.evidence: The figure contains three separate pie charts, not one pie chart with eight slices. The atom checklist specifies three pie charts with 4, 3, and 2 slices respectively.
The description incorrectly splits "Existential Quantifiers" into two separate slices ("Existential" and "Quantifiers"). The figure shows one slice for "Existential Quantifiers" at 15.12%.
"Existential Quantifiers" is a single slice at 15.12%, not two slices. The 27.91% value is incorrectly assigned to "Quantifiers" instead of "Limiter" or "Negation".
The "Negation" slice is colored orange in the figure, not pink.
"Absolute Absence" is a single slice in light purple at 18.71%, not two separate slices. "Approximate Quantities" is beige, not light blue, and is 45.03%, not 36.26%.
"Comparative Relationships" is 36.26%, not 49.51%. The 49.51% value corresponds to "Disjunctive" in the "Disjunctive & Conjunctive" chart.
"Conjunctive" is light pink, not light blue.
The description does not mention that the slices for "Disjunctive & Conjunctive" are part of a separate pie chart with two slices.

errors.text_span: The slices appear visually ordered from smallest to largest, with the exception of “Quantifiers” and "Limiter".
errors.evidence: The figure does not show any specific ordering of slices by size. This claim is not supported by any atom or visual evidence.
The term "Quantifiers" is ambiguous and does not clearly refer to "Universal Quantifiers" or "Existential Quantifiers".

errors.text_span: The categories and their approximate percentages are: “Existential” (green, 15.12%), “Quantifiers” (green, 27.91%), “Limiter” (pink, 27.91%), “Negation” (pink, 27.91%), “Universal Quantifiers” (blue, 29.07%), "Absolute” (light blue, 18.71%), "Absence” (light blue, 45.03%), “Approximate Quantities” (light blue, 36.26%), “Comparative Relationships” (light blue, 49.51%), and "Conjunctive" (light blue, 50.49%).
errors.evidence: The description is overly verbose due to incorrect splitting of slices and redundant listing of colors and percentages.
